reason: Candidate A more directly addresses the requirement of boosting coercivity within an equiatomic FeCoNi-based high-entropy composition by substituting an element (Ir) known to enhance magnetocrystalline anisotropy. This single-composition intervention is physically well grounded, builds upon prior Pt/Pd doping work without simply repeating it, and proposes a concise, testable experiment with a clear criterion for falsification.
